name: research-skills
description: Research workflow skills: sharpen vague ideas into plans, run audited theory searches, read arxiv papers, and write rigorous reports and papers.

interface.longDescription: Five composable skills covering the research loop: sharpen a vague idea into a falsifiable project contract and prediction-annotated roadmap, launch audited multi-agent theory searches, read arxiv papers from TeX source, write rigorous experiment reports with QA-checked PDFs, and write submission-ready machine-learning papers.
defaultPrompt: Sharpen this vague idea into a project contract and experiment roadmap.
Launch an audited multi-agent search for this theory problem.
Read this arxiv paper and summarize it for the current project.
Turn these experiment artifacts into a rigorous report.
Turn my research results into a submission-ready paper.
